simulate_microlens_array: simulate a plane wave incident on a microlens array with quadratic profile and return electric and magnetic fields
circle_density: generate a density array for a centered circular feature given a radius, pitch, and grid shape
discrete_profile_layer_thicknesses: compute layer thicknesses for a discrete approximation of a monotonically increasing profile function
lens_profile: return the z-coordinate for a quadratic lens profile given radial position, height, and pitch
lens_coordinates: generate the x and z coordinates of a discretized microlens profile for plotting purposes
